title: The year-ahead tarot spread
description: How to lay out and read a year-ahead tarot spread: one theme card and twelve monthly cards, with tips for reading patterns and using it as a reflection tool.

scenes.headline: The year-ahead tarot spread
scenes.caption: The year-ahead tarot spread uses a theme card plus one card for each month. It works best as a prompt for planning and reflection, not as a forecast.
scenes.vo: The year-ahead tarot spread uses a theme card plus one card for each month. It works best as a prompt for planning and reflection, not as a forecast.

scenes.headline: How the layout works
scenes.caption: Place the first card at the top centre. This is your theme card, a lens for the whole year.
scenes.vo: How the layout works. Place the first card at the top centre. This is your theme card, a lens for the whole year.

scenes.headline: Preparing the question
scenes.caption: A broad question is fine here, because the spread already provides structure.
scenes.vo: Preparing the question. A broad question is fine here, because the spread already provides structure.

scenes.headline: Have a tarot spread in front of you?
scenes.caption: Photograph it and get a clear reading, card by card.
